name: Projection Morph
desc: The whole world endlessly reshaping itself as it morphs between map projections — a filled continents-and-ocean globe that unrolls from a sphere into Mercator, folds into an elliptical Mollweide and Hammer, splays into a sinusoidal, then balls back up and spins, its graticule of meridians and parallels flexing through every seam.
